_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#3. Measured on skfem 12.0.1, a 1-D-in-x advection-diffusion boundary layer on MeshQuad, eps=1e-3, inlet 0 / outlet 1: plain CG undershoots at every mesh in a four-level refinement sweep (nx 10..80, cell Peclet 50 down to 6.25) and the undershoot never clears; SUPG with the standard coth-tau removes it at EVERY level including the coarsest. Sharpens the claim's 'do not damp under refinement': the undershoot does shrink, but it survives as long as the cell Peclet exceeds ~1, so clearing it by refinement alone costs more than an order of magnitude in DOFs. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the plain-Galerkin leg of the sweep as solve_layer(nx, supg=MUTATE), i.e. adds the documented SUPG coth-tau term to the wrong variant. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 5 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'cg_undershoots_at_every_level=True', 'cg_undershoot_survives_to_finest=True' and 'supg_fixes_coarsest_mesh=True' (and emits the forbidden 'FAIL:'), so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
